author: Widogeist
body: I'd recommend sending an email to help@playorna.com, explain the situation and why you think it might be spoofing/botting, and provide screenshots and any other additional information you think might help support your case.  They'll look at the player in question, their activity log, any potential "red flags", and take action if they find anything that indicates breach of ToS.

author: QuoteGiver
body:
If there IS car access, high level players are able to take areas in basically one click, so if they’re a passenger in the car they can zip along taking areas as fast as the car can go.

But if you’re able to remember where these areas are and know that’s not possible, then that’s a decent indicator of shenanigans, yeah.
